title: Self Defence and Girls Safety
summary: A Self Defence and Girls Safety session was conducted at Sane Guruji Vidya Mandir for 125+ students from Classes 7 to 10.
description: A Self Defence and Girls Safety session was conducted at Sane Guruji Vidya Mandir for 125+ students from Classes 7 to 10. Mr Ajay Shah, an International Martial Arts Black Belt, explained probable situations and places where attacks may occur and demonstrated basic techniques for self-protection and escape. Students were shown how everyday objects such as a pen, mobile phone, hair clip and comb could be used for protection during a sudden attack. The session also emphasised self-confidence and maintaining a calm state of mind to respond effectively. Various safety tools, including pepper spray and SOS alarms, were introduced. The session concluded with students asking situational questions, which the speaker addressed.
location: Sane Guruji Vidya Mandir, Mumbai, Maharashtra
